title: Zero / One / Many ground-truth intervals
description: Ground-truth temporal intervals for a query family. Cardinality is derived from the number of intervals: zero -> empty-set, one -> single, many -> multiple. Empty-set (zero) requires full human review of the declared scope (§21.5). Intervals are same-video/same-camera; the system never infers identity across discontinuous gaps or cameras. See RAZIEL_Master_Execution_Plan_v1.3.md §21.3.

cardinality.description: Declared expected cardinality. MUST be consistent with len(intervals): zero->0, one->1, many->>=2 (enforced by eval/schema.py cross-field check).

t0.description: Start in source PTS seconds. Time is PTS-based, never frame_index/declared_fps.

t1.description: End in source PTS seconds. Must satisfy t1 >= t0 (cross-field check).

repeated_event_group.description: Links occurrences that are the same recurring event (§21.4 repeated_events).
